bullets.text: Premier League Soccer Live - **Manchester United** faces **West Ham** at Old Trafford, streaming options available.
Apple's Christmas Trees - **Apple** showcases iPad-designed trees at **Battersea Power Station** until December 24.
Kohler's Privacy Concerns - **Kohler** faces scrutiny over data practices for its **Dekoda** toilet camera.
iPhone 17 Pro Changes - **Apple** removes Night mode from Portrait mode in the **iPhone 17 Pro** camera app.
Spotify Wrapped Party - **Spotify** introduces a new party feature for its annual Wrapped experience.
AWS re:Invent Highlights - **AWS** focuses on AI advancements and enterprise solutions at its annual conference.
Waymo Under Investigation - **Waymo** faces federal scrutiny over robotaxis illegally passing school buses.
Harvey's Valuation Surge - **Harvey**, a legal AI startup, confirms an $8 billion valuation after recent funding.
Dynamic Pricing Issues - **Amazon's** dynamic pricing affects school budgets, causing significant cost increases.
California's Truck Regulations - Proposed changes may lift California's ban on testing self-driving trucks.
